evidence: The cleaner head features dual front and rear roller drives with color-coded blue and red components and a central slide-out Debris Tray, which matches the Dyson WashG1 wet floor cleaner.
contradictions: All other catalogue candidates are dry vacuum cleaners that do not feature dual wet rollers or a slide-out Debris Tray.

candidate_checks.evidence: The dual counter-rotating roller side drive with color-coded blue and red caps and central Debris Tray matches the WashG1 floorhead.
The V16 All Floor Cones Sense head features conical dry rollers and lacks a slide-out Debris Tray.
V8 Absolute uses single-roller dry floorheads without dual wet rollers or a Debris Tray.
Big Ball canister cleaner heads do not feature motorized dual wet rollers or an integrated Debris Tray.
V12 Detect Slim uses single-roller dry cleaner heads rather than a dual-roller wet system with a Debris Tray.
V15 Detect uses single-roller dry cleaner heads and lacks the dual wet-roller drive and Debris Tray.
